demo-data.description: Meridian's demo databases (the music store and the pet store) through MCP Toolbox for Databases: named queries only, no free SQL.

serviceAccount.name: demo SQLite files
serviceAccount.description: The two SQLite files shipped in the pack, opened by the Toolbox server; nobody signs in to them.

demo-catalog.description: The data team's column catalog for the music store (a stand-in for BigQuery policy tags): one named query, aiso_column_tags, read by AI Stackops to classify the demo-data columns. No agent uses it.

serviceAccount.name: demo catalog file
serviceAccount.description: The catalog SQLite file shipped in the pack, opened by the Toolbox server.

demo-sql.description: The music store through MCP Toolbox with one free-SQL tool, run_sql, over a copy of the database: for builders, each statement read by the SQL check before it runs (scenario 30).

serviceAccount.name: demo SQLite copy
serviceAccount.description: A copy of the music store's SQLite file, opened by the Toolbox server; nobody signs in to it.

change-desk.description: Meridian's change desk (scenario 43): files plant change requests after the person confirms (MCP elicitation) and asks the host's model for change-log summaries (MCP sampling, off until an admin allows it). A Node script in the pack, no dependencies, nothing on the network.
